Mia (CSM): FYI we have a spend spike for acct 'Forklift' during onboarding. QBR on Tue, need a concise triage summary and owner list for the slide. Internal notes: https://redwood.internal/forklift-onboard

Omar (AM): saw the alert. Looks embeddings-heavy with a few long-context chat flows. I'll pull a token heatmap and per-route breakdown and post results here.

cost-bot: ALERT: Account=Forklift projected to exceed committed credits by 28% within 7d. Top sources: embeddings=62%, chat-gen=30%.

Sasha (FinOps): Can someone run a 14d token rollup? quick SQL example: `SELECT product, SUM(tokens) FROM usage WHERE account='forklift' AND ts > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY product;` Need exact numbers for the QBR slide.

Leo (Solutions Eng): I can spin up a staging config test. Probable quick wins: enable prefix KV cache on search route, cap embedding batch size, and rate-limit ingestion. ETA ~3h for experiment + delta report.

Mia (CSM): good. Omar & Leo, drop a 3-4 bullet remediation plan here so I can paste into the deck. Keep it customer-facing: what we changed now, what we recommend next, owner/resolution ETA.

Omar (AM): Triage bullets: 1) Immediate: throttle embedding ingestion to 600 TPS for onboarding window (owner: Omar). 2) Short-term: enable per-account prefix KV caching for repeated queries (owner: Leo). 3) Ops: create budget alert at 70% of committed credits and add webhook to CS slack (owner: Sasha). 4) Next: 1-hr enablement call with Forklift devs to review prompt shaping and deduping (owner: Mia).

Leo (Solutions Eng): Staging command I'll run:
`curl -X POST https://dedicated.redwood/v1/accounts/forklift/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"kv_cache":true,"embedding_batch_limit":256,"ingest_rate_limit":600}'`
I'll post token delta and latency impact after the 1h window.

Sasha (FinOps): Also recommend cost-aware routing fallback: route non-critical background endpoints to quantized model variant to save ~30-40% per-request token cost. I can attach projected $ savings to the slide once Omar posts token counts.

Mia (CSM): perfect. Who will present the cost section at QBR? @Omar?

Omar (AM): I got it. Will include the numbers + mitigation plan. :thumbsup:
